Name: Builder Assistant 建筑助手
Description: Android-first Builder Assistant. v0.8.1 makes import frictionless: no more creating folders or hand-writing files — copy a blueprint JSON onto the phone clipboard, tap the Blueprint Tool (903) and it paste-imports directly. The pasted text runs through a new pure BlueprintImportService that reuses the SAME BlueprintJson.Decode parser + vanilla-material pre-flight as file import (no second parser), enforces a raw-size cap, and on success auto-saves a uniquely-named, NON-overwriting copy to the library while preserving the readable (CJK) display name inside the JSON — fixing the old bug where pure Chinese names all collapsed to 'blueprint' and clobbered each other. Illegal input (empty, over-size, malformed JSON, unknown material, duplicate coords, over cap) is rejected with a precise reason and NEVER touches the current clipboard or writes terrain. The loaded blueprint is then placed with the existing Builder Tool (901) two-tap confirm through the SAME BuildPlanner/BuildTask/undo pipeline, so every safety rule (main-thread-only writes, single-player WorkType.Local gate, default no-overwrite + explicit confirm, chunk-readiness pre-check, batched apply, safe rollback/undo) is unchanged. The clipboard read is wrapped in a guarded adapter (GameInterop) because Game.ClipboardManager is a public Game.* type that is NOT part of the documented SCNET Mod API: it compiles against the verified Windows x25.01.17 assembly, but its Android/7723 runtime is 待验证, and when unavailable it falls back gracefully to the v0.8.0 toast + file-library browse. A separate reserved interface for an Android SAF file picker is stubbed but marked 不支持 (未接入) pending native-call verification. Offline Core+Generators+JSON+browser+import+naming tests now pass 194/194, XDB merge-safety guards 7/7, net472 compiles 0 errors/0 warnings against the real x25.01.17 assemblies. v0.8.0 closed the loop 'external AI writes a blueprint JSON -> drop it on the phone -> import -> build'. New: a dedicated in-hand Blueprint Tool block (item 903). Each tap browses the Mod's blueprint library folder and loads+validates the next blueprint through the existing BlueprintJson.Decode plus the vanilla-material pre-flight; an illegal or AI-bad file (malformed JSON, over cap, unsupported block, dangling material) is rejected with a clear reason and NEVER touches the clipboard or partially imports. When the library is empty the tool prints the real library folder path (under ModsManager.UserDataPath, never a hardcoded device path) so the player can drop AI-generated .json files in with the Android system file manager. The Android file-delivery path (whether the system file manager can write UserDataPath under scoped storage) and item index 903 are 待验证 (pending real-device verification). v0.7.0 adds the generic JSON blueprint bridge that will carry future AI-generated buildings. New: a dependency-free strict JSON parser/writer (Core/Json), a blueprint exchange format (BlueprintJson, schemaVersion=1) with serialize/parse/validate round-trip, two-corner live-region COPY (BlueprintCopier) that reads real blocks into a blueprint and auto-exports it, and PASTE that rebuilds a copied or imported blueprint through the SAME BuildPlanner/BuildTask/undo pipeline as the built-in cottage so every safety rule applies identically. Blueprints persist to the Mod's own library under ModsManager.UserDataPath (never a hardcoded device path), which is also the answer to Android local-file access. Fidelity is deliberately conservative: only verified plain-cube vanilla blocks are copied/pasted; stairs, slabs, oriented logs, plants, snow, fluids and entity-bearing blocks are skipped on copy and cause a clear rejection on import/paste instead of a degraded or garbage build. Quarter-turn rotation lives in pure blueprint space. Reserved-but-unsupported fields (per-cell orientation/data/props, top-level buildOps) are rejected loudly, never faked. Undo still only restores cells the player has not since edited. The game-adapter copy/paste/import paths and all Android behavior remain 待验证 (pending real-device verification). v0.6.3 adds clear-soft and a bounded stall. Clear-soft: grass/flowers/tall grass/dead bushes/snow layers and other walk-through blocks the engine flags IsCollidable==false can now be replaced by a build, but only after an explicit extra confirmation tap — never by default; fluids (water/lava), solid terrain and player structures are still refused, and undo restores the exact original plant value. Bounded stall: our own writes can briefly drop a chunk's State below Valid during the engine re-mesh; instead of aborting and rolling back the whole cottage for that transient, the executor pauses in place and retries on the next frame, giving up (with a safe rollback) only after MaxIdleAdvanceCallsDuringBuild consecutive zero-progress calls. v0.6.2 fixed the on-device false '区块未加载' abort: editability now keys on `chunk.State == Valid AND chunk.Cells != null` (never TerrainChunk.IsLoaded) and prints real chunk coordinates. v0.6.1 fixed a shipped database-merge crash from a reused Class-parameter GUID. v0.6 keeps the independent speedboat prototype (behavior unchanged).
